description: Independent LibreGet fork of OmniGet with course, video, music, and social-platform downloads plus built-in media tools.
pre_install: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $legacyCurrent) { throw "Uninstall the previous 'omniget' package first with 'scoop uninstall omniget'. Its persisted data will be moved automatically when you install 'omniget-openselena'." }
if ($runningApps.Count -gt 0) { throw 'Close OmniGet/LibreGet before migrating the old persisted data.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $newDataDir) { throw 'Both old and renamed LibreGet data folders exist. Back up and reconcile them before installing.' }
if ($null -eq $portableExe) { throw 'The LibreGet Windows x64 portable executable was not found.' }
post_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'LibreGet.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'LibreGet.exe was not installed in the Scoop version directory.' }

script: if ($portableAssets.Count -eq 0) { throw 'Latest LibreGet release has no Windows x64 portable executable.' }
$asset = $portableAssets | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { if ($_.name -like 'libreget_*') { 0 } else { 1 } } }, name | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $assetMatch.Success) { throw 'Could not parse the LibreGet portable asset version.' }

notes: Creates portable.txt beside LibreGet.exe so settings, databases, cookies, plugins, caches, downloader tools, and WebView2 data are stored in the Scoop-persisted data directory.
The package name 'omniget-openselena' preserves the independent OpenSelena fork while 'omniget' is reserved for the original tonhowtf project.
The first install migrates the former persist\omniget\data folder here when it exists. Close and uninstall the previous 'omniget' package first; Scoop retains its persist directory during uninstall.
Use 'scoop update omniget-openselena' for updates rather than the in-app updater, so Scoop retains control of the installed version.
